stem.text: Two experiments, X and Y, were carried out using an enzyme from humans.

Experiment X was carried out at a constant temperature of $37\,{}^{\circ}\text{C}$. During experiment Y, the temperature was increased from $37\,{}^{\circ}\text{C}$ to $80\,{}^{\circ}\text{C}$. All other factors were kept the same.
